import requests

GALAXY_URL = "https://usegalaxy.org"

r = requests.get(f"{base_url}/datasets/{DATASET_ID}/display", headers=headers)
data = r.text

lines = data.strip().split('\n')

# Count genes meeting criteria
total = 0
upregulated = []
upregulated_genes = []
for line in lines[1:]:  # skip header
    cols = line.split('\t')
    if len(cols) < 7:
        continue
    gene = cols[0]
    lfc = cols[2]
    padj = cols[6]
    
    total += 1
    
    # Skip NA padj
    if padj == 'NA' or padj == '':
        continue
    
    lfc_val = float(lfc)
    padj_val = float(padj)
    
    if lfc_val > 1.5 and padj_val < 0.05:
        upregulated.append(line)
        upregulated_genes.append(gene)

print(f"Total genes in results: {total}")
print(f"Upregulated (log2FC > 1.5, padj < 0.05): {len(upregulated)}")
print(f"Downregulated (log2FC < -1.5, padj < 0.05): waiting...")

# Also check downregulated
down = sum(1 for line in lines[1:] 
           if len(line.split('\t')) >= 7 
           and line.split('\t')[6] not in ('NA', '')
           and float(line.split('\t')[6]) < 0.05
           and float(line.split('\t')[2]) < -1.5)

print(f"Downregulated (log2FC < -1.5, padj < 0.05): {down}")

# Check total with valid padj
valid_padj = sum(1 for line in lines[1:]
                 if len(line.split('\t')) >= 7
                 and line.split('\t')[6] not in ('NA', ''))
print(f"Genes with non-NA padj: {valid_padj}")

print(f"\nFirst 5 upregulated genes:")
for g in upregulated_genes[:5]:
    print(f"  {g}")

# Show some genes near the threshold

near = [(cols[0], float(cols[2]), float(cols[6])) 
        for line in lines[1:] 
        if len((cols := line.split('\t'))) >= 7
        and cols[6] not in ('NA', '')
        and 1.5 < float(cols[2]) < 2.0
        and float(cols[6]) < 0.05]
for g, lfc, padj in near[:5]:
    print(f"  {g}: log2FC={lfc:.3f}, padj={padj:.2e}")

import requests

r1 = requests.get("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau", timeout=30)
link_lines = r1.text.strip().split('\n')

# Get pathway names
r2 = requests.get("https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau", timeout=30)
path_lines = r2.text.strip().split('\n')

# Build pathway name lookup
pathway_names = {}
for line in path_lines:
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        pathway_names[parts[0]] = parts[1]

# Create 3-column mapping: gene_id, pathway_id, pathway_name
mapping = []
for line in link_lines:
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        gene_full = parts[0]  # e.g., pau:PA14_07190
        pathway_full = parts[1]  # e.g., path:pau00010
        
        # Strip prefix for gene ID
        gene_id = gene_full.replace('pau:', '')
        
        # Strip prefix for pathway ID
        pathway_id = pathway_full.replace('path:', '')
        
        pathway_name = pathway_names.get(pathway_id, 'Unknown')
        
        mapping.append((gene_id, pathway_id, pathway_name))

print(f"Total mapping entries: {len(mapping)}")
print(f"First 5:")
for m in mapping[:5]:
    print(f"  {m[0]}\t{m[1]}\t{m[2]}")

    f.write("gene_id\tpathway_id\tpathway_name\n")
    for gene_id, pathway_id, pathway_name in mapping:
        f.write(f"{gene_id}\t{pathway_id}\t{pathway_name}\n")

    next(f)  # skip header

        upregulated.append(line.strip())

print(f"Not mapped: {len(upregulated) - len(mapped_up)}")

abc_up = [g for g in upregulated if g in abc_genes]
print(f"Upregulated genes mapping to ABC transporters: {len(abc_up)}")
for g in abc_up:
    print(f"  {g}")
